notes.title: Urban Trial Tricky has landed on Nintendo Switch! Watch new trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34475381/60b6488f10b19b4e2be30dd9a78c2a4f64e87a6e.png[/img]


The time has come for Urban Trial Tricky to hit Nintendo Switch! After a quite successful pre-order period this crazy arcade game is now fully available on Nintendo eShop. 

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/urban-trial-tricky-switch/]Nintendo eShop US[/url]
[url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Urban-Trial-Tricky-1795393.html]Nintendo eShop EU
[/url]
For everyone who wishes to pull off the best tricks, score the most awesome combos, and rule the leaderboards Urban Trial Tricky is available now with a 10% discount. 

For all the Urban Trial lovers, who already have [b]Urban Trial Playground (currently on Nintendo charts) we have prepared a 30% Owner Discount![/b]

Watch new trailer: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VBHE_w1TZ1w]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VBHE_w1TZ1w[/url]

Urban Trial Tricky is available in the Americas, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand and soon to be released in Japan. The game is localized to 12 languages and runs in smooth 60fps!

Players are introduced to 3 single player modes: Tricks, Time Challenge and Competition set in a cartoon style urban environment full of ramps and kickers. 

It’s important to find a unique style! Players have the most savage and funny costumes to choose from - Banana, Hot Dog, Zombie, and more ... and we can already give a little sneak peek - even more is coming!
